title: WarmStart LAMP® Protocol
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xppfmmn
materials: Spray entire work area with RNAway.
Allow reagents to thaw on ice
Vortex mix all reagents for approximately 00:00:05 .
Hit PROCEED to select a reaction cycle.
Spin down all reagents for approximately 00:00:05 .

steps.title: Prepare Work Area
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the workspace and equipment to prevent contamination.

substeps.instruction: Spray the entire work area, including pipettes, tip holder for PCR tubes, and work surface, with 70% EtOH.
Wipe the area with a paper towel.

steps.title: Prepare Cooling Station
steps.instruction: Set up an ice bath to keep reagents cold.

substeps.instruction: Fill a styrofoam container halfway with ice.
Set the PCR tube holder on the ice and allow it to cool for 00:03:00.

steps.title: Thaw Reagents
steps.instruction: Move necessary reagents from the freezer to the chilled PCR tube holder.

substeps.instruction: Transfer Master Mix, primers, RNAse free water, and target tubes to the PCR tube holder on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Reaction Vessels
steps.instruction: Label and prepare the PCR tubes, ensuring no contamination of the tube interiors or caps.

substeps.instruction: Label one tube as 'NTC' and the other as 'TARG'.
Touch only the outside of the tubes when handling.

steps.title: Assemble Reaction Mixture
steps.instruction: Add reagents to the reaction vessels using the specified pipettes and volumes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 9 µL RNAse free water into the TARGET vessel and 10 µL RNAse free water into the NTC vessel using a 2-20 μL pipette.
Transfer 2.5 µL Primer (e.g., tube labeled 'F' for E. Coli OH157) into each vessel using a 0.5-10 μL pipette.
Transfer 12.5 µL WarmStart Master Mix into each vessel using a 2-20 μL pipette.
Transfer 1 µL Target into the TARGET reaction vessel using a 0.5-10 μL pipette.

steps.title: Mix and Spin Samples
steps.instruction: Homogenize the reaction mixture and collect the liquid at the bottom of the tubes.

steps.title: Run Thermocycler Program
steps.instruction: Load the samples into the thermocycler and initiate the LAMP3 program.

substeps.instruction: Place reaction vessels into the thermocycler.
Use the arrow keys to select 'LAMP3'.
